description: 2x2 Pocket Cube Moves: each face Turn applied corner-only from a solved Cube (ADR 0005). Corner Stickers (f*9 + 0,2,6,8) permute exactly as on the 3x3; the 30 Phantom Stickers (edges and centers) stay frozen at their solved colors. Each case applies moves corner-only to start (a solved Cube when start is absent) and must produce expect. solved is whether the result is solved. phantomsSolved asserts every Phantom Sticker still holds its solved color. Corner states were derived from the independently verified 3x3 move results in moves.json by freezing the Phantom Stickers.
